capabilities.title: Stable element ids
capabilities.requirement: every element of the stand carries a stable id: the author's key where given, else its component path
capabilities.observed_gap: a node's id is a slot index plus a version; a remount re-clones nodes into fresh ids, and no semantic id exists — an agent can aim only at coordinates or selectors.

verification.acceptance: On every stand task, every element in the screen reads an id; elements the author keyed read that key, and the rest read their component path.

capabilities.title: Id persistence
capabilities.requirement: an element's id is identical across a re-render, a remount and a fresh process
capabilities.observed_gap: a node's id is a slot index plus a version; a remount re-clones nodes into fresh ids, and no semantic id exists — an agent can aim only at coordinates or selectors.

verification.acceptance: For each stand element, the id read before and after a re-render, a remount, and a restart in a new process is the same.

capabilities.title: Id coherence
capabilities.requirement: an element has the same id in the snapshot, the accessibility tree and the driver
capabilities.observed_gap: a node's id is a slot index plus a version; a remount re-clones nodes into fresh ids, and no semantic id exists — an agent can aim only at coordinates or selectors.

verification.acceptance: For each stand element, the id in the snapshot, the id on its accessibility node, and the id the driver accepts to act on it are identical.

capabilities.title: Compact semantic snapshot
capabilities.requirement: one command returns the screen as a tree of id · role · name · state · bounds, readable whole in one tool result
capabilities.observed_gap: the screen is readable only as an HTML string, a debug tree print or a screenshot — large, noisy or lossy for an agent.

verification.acceptance: One snapshot command returns each stand task's screen as a tree where every node carries id, role, name, state and bounds, and the whole result fits in a single tool result.

capabilities.title: Snapshot state fidelity
capabilities.requirement: snapshot state reflects enabled, checked, value and focused; a disabled control reads disabled, a typed value reads its value
capabilities.observed_gap: the screen is readable only as an HTML string, a debug tree print or a screenshot — large, noisy or lossy for an agent.

verification.acceptance: On the stand, a disabled control reads disabled, a checked control reads checked, the focused control reads focused, and text typed into a field reads back as its value.

capabilities.title: Post-action diff
capabilities.requirement: after an action the driver returns exactly the nodes that changed; an action that changes nothing returns an empty diff
capabilities.observed_gap: no mutation stream exists, changed nodes are never drained, and has_changes() answers inverted.

verification.acceptance: After a stand action, the returned diff names exactly the nodes whose snapshot changed and no others; an action that changes nothing returns an empty diff.

capabilities.title: Headless screenshot
capabilities.requirement: the driver screenshots the whole screen or one element with no display
capabilities.observed_gap: a CPU raster and a PNG writer exist, apart from the test harness; the harness has no screenshot.

verification.acceptance: With no display present, the driver returns an image of the whole stand screen and an image cropped to one element addressed by its id.

capabilities.title: Screenshot determinism
capabilities.requirement: a repeated screenshot on the same host yields the same pixels
capabilities.observed_gap: a CPU raster and a PNG writer exist, apart from the test harness; the harness has no screenshot.

verification.acceptance: Two screenshots of the same stand state taken in separate runs on the same host are pixel-identical.

capabilities.title: Act by id
capabilities.requirement: driver actions target an element by its stable id
capabilities.observed_gap: the test harness clicks at a box's centre, by selector or coordinates, and a check must pump or wait on its own.

verification.acceptance: Every driver action on the stand is addressed by an element's stable id alone, with no coordinates or selectors, and takes effect on that element.

capabilities.title: Settled actions
capabilities.requirement: acting returns only once the UI has settled; a stand flow with a delayed update passes with no sleep anywhere in the check
capabilities.observed_gap: the test harness clicks at a box's centre, by selector or coordinates, and a check must pump or wait on its own.

verification.acceptance: A stand flow whose action triggers a delayed update (the timer task) passes with the post-action state already present when the action returns, and no sleep or wait appears anywhere in the check.

capabilities.title: Explainable refusals
capabilities.requirement: an action that cannot happen is refused with its cause named: not found · stale · disabled · covered by another element · off-screen
capabilities.observed_gap: an action that cannot take effect gives no reason.

verification.acceptance: On the stand, an action aimed at a missing element, a stale id, a disabled control, an element covered by another, and an off-screen element is each refused, and each refusal names its cause.

capabilities.title: Command line
capabilities.requirement: every driver command runs from a CLI with JSON output and an exit code meaning accepted or refused; a stand flow is scriptable in shell alone
capabilities.observed_gap: the headless harness is a Rust API in a test-only crate (publish = false) — no command an agent runs.

verification.acceptance: Every driver command runs from the command line with JSON output and a process status that tells accepted from refused, and a stand flow completes as a shell script with no other tooling.

capabilities.title: MCP surface
capabilities.requirement: the same commands are exposed as MCP tools, and an agent session completes a stand flow through them

verification.acceptance: Every command available on the command line is also offered as an MCP tool, and an agent session completes a stand flow using only those tools.

capabilities.title: Self-describing API
capabilities.requirement: one consistent verb set, with help and schemas served by the tool itself, and every refusal naming its remedy
capabilities.observed_gap: none — a user learns the harness from its source.

verification.acceptance: The tool itself serves its verb list, help and schemas on both surfaces from one verb set, and every refusal cause the stand can provoke names a remedy.

capabilities.title: Cold-agent test
capabilities.requirement: a fresh agent given only the tool completes a stand task and writes a passing check, with its wrong calls counted
capabilities.observed_gap: none — a user learns the harness from its source.

verification.acceptance: A fresh agent with no prior context, given only the tool, completes a stand task and writes a check that passes; the run records its count of wrong calls.
